shared_elements: anthropomorphic figure with head and body
patterned/textured surface treatment suggesting scales or feathers
non-human or hybrid head on a human-like body
justification: Both depict a humanoid figure whose surface is covered with incised scale- or feather-like patterning, and both give the figure a non-naturalistic head, but that is where correspondence ends. A shows a precise low-relief winged bird-headed figure in strict profile, striding with raised arm, holding a bucket, framed by rows of rosettes and stylised plants; B is a blocky frontal, heavily schematic three-dimensional figure with a broad flat face and stacked forms, without wings, attributes or any surrounding ornament.
